title: GPT Image
wikitext: {{Short description|Image-generation models developed by OpenAI}} {{Infobox software | name = GPT Image | logo = | logo caption = | screenshot = English Wikipedia screenshot by GPT Image 2.png | caption = English Wikipedia "screenshot" generated by GPT Image 2 | collapsible = Yes | author = | developer = [[OpenAI]] | released = {{Start date and age|df=y|2025|3|25}} | latest release version = GPT Image 2 | latest release date = {{start date and age|df=y|2026|4|21}} | replaces = [[DALL-E]] | repo = | programming language = | operating system = | genre = [[Text-to-image model|Image generation]] and [[image editing|editing]] | license = | website = {{URL|https://chatgpt.com/images|ChatGPT Images 2.0}} }} {{Artificial intelligence}} '''GPT Image''' is a series of [[Artificial intelligence visual art|image generation]] and [[Image editing|editing]] models developed by [[OpenAI]]. A [[text-to-image model|text-to-image]] variant of the [[generative pre-trained transformer|GPT]] family, it uses [[deep learning]] methodologies to generate [[digital image]]s from [[natural language]] [[Prompt engineering|descriptions]] or images precisely. As the successor to [[DALL-E]], GPT Image is native to [[ChatGPT]] as '''ChatGPT Images''' and available through the [[API]]. Upon release in March 2025, GPT Image went viral on social media, particularly for its capability of generating images in the style of [[Studio Ghibli]]. GPT Image is also available with [[Microsoft Copilot]] and [[Apple Intelligence]] as well. == History == The first model of GPT Image was revealed by OpenAI as the "GPT-4o image generation" in a blog post on March 25, 2025, developed based on the [[GPT-4o]] model to generate images.{{cite web |title=Introducing 4o Image Generation |url=https://openai.com/index/introducing-4o-image-generation/ |publisher=OpenAI |access-date=17 December 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251005023441/https://openai.com/index/introducing-4o-image-generation/ |archive-date=5 October 2025 |date=25 March 2025}} It was initially made available to only paid users, with the rollout to free users delayed due to high demands.{{cite news |last=Roth |first=Emma |title=ChatGPT's new image generator is delayed for free users |url=https://www.theverge.com/news/636948/openai-chatgpt-image-generation-gpt-4o |access-date=March 26, 2025 |work=The Verge |date=March 26, 2025}} The use of the feature was subsequently limited, with [[Sam Altman]] saying that the [[GPUs]] were "melting" from the level of use.{{cite news |last1=Welch |first1=Chris |title=OpenAI says "our GPUs are melting" as it limits ChatGPT image generation requests |url=https://www.theverge.com/news/637542/chatgpt-says-our-gpus-are-melting-as-it-puts-limit-on-image-generation-requests |access-date=March 28, 2025 |work=The Verge |date=March 27, 2025}} OpenAI later said that over 130 million users around the world had created more than 700 million images in the first week⁠.{{cite web |title=Introducing our latest image generation model in the API |url=https://openai.com/index/image-generation-api/ |publisher=OpenAI |access-date=30 April 2025 |date=23 April 2025}} The model was named as '''GPT Image 1''' (gpt-image-1) and introduced to the API on April 23. A cost-efficient version was released as '''GPT Image 1 Mini''' (gpt-image-1-mini) on October 6, also OpenAI DevDay 2025, with the cost in the API 80% less expensive than GPT Image 1.{{cite web |title=OpenAI DevDay 2025 |url=https://openai.com/devday/ |publisher=OpenAI |access-date=17 December 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251021174654/https://openai.com/devday/ |archive-date=21 October 2025 |date=6 October 2025}}{{cite web |author1=Matthias Bastian |title=Developers can now build and deploy both apps and agents directly on the ChatGPT platform |url=https://the-decoder.com/developers-can-now-build-and-deploy-both-apps-and-agents-directly-on-the-chatgpt-platform/ |publisher=The Decoder |access-date=17 December 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251007121637/https://the-decoder.com/developers-can-now-build-and-deploy-both-apps-and-agents-directly-on-the-chatgpt-platform/ |archive-date=7 October 2025 |date=6 October 2025}} A new model named '''GPT Image 1.5''' (gpt-image-1.5) was introduced on December 16, which was rolled out globally as the "ChatGPT Images" to all users and immediately made available via the API.{{cite web |title=The new ChatGPT Images is here |url=https://openai.com/index/new-chatgpt-images-is-here/ |publisher=OpenAI |access-date=17 December 2025 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20251217045319/https://openai.com/index/new-chatgpt-images-is-here/ |archive-date=17 December 2025 |date=16 December 2025}} OpenAI claimed that the new model can make precise edits while keeping details intact, and generates images up to four times faster. Image inputs and outputs in the API are 20% cheaper in GPT Image 1.5 as compared to GPT Image 1.{{cite web |title=Pricing |url=https://platform.openai.com/docs/pricing#image-generation |website=OpenAI Platform |publisher=OpenAI |access-date=17 December 2025}} In April 2026, OpenAI released '''GPT Image 2''' (gpt-image-2) which introduced a reasoning model into their generation.{{Cite web |last=Silberling |first=Amanda |date=2026-04-21 |title=ChatGPT's new Images 2.0 model is surprisingly good at generating text |url=https://techcrunch.com/2026/04/21/chatgpts-new-images-2-0-model-is-surprisingly-good-at-generating-text/ |access-date=2026-04-21 |website=TechCrunch |language=en-US}} == Capabilities == Unlike the [[diffusion model|diffusion]] predecessors of DALL-E 2 and DALL-E 3 models, GPT Image models are [[autoregressive model|autoregressive]] with several new capabilities including [[image editing|image-to-image]] transformation, advanced [[photorealism]] and detailed instruction following.{{cite web |title=Addendum to GPT-4o System Card: Native image generation |url=https://cdn.openai.com/11998be9-5319-4302-bfbf-1167e093f1fb/Native_Image_Generation_System_Card.pdf |publisher=OpenAI |access-date=17 December 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250820220216/https://cdn.openai.com/11998be9-5319-4302-bfbf-1167e093f1fb/Native_Image_Generation_System_Card.pdf |archive-date=20 August 2025 |format=PDF |date=25 March 2025}} GPT Image can generate images in three sizes, namely 1024 × 1024 (1:1, square), 1536 × 1024 (3:2, landscape), and 1024 × 1536 (2:3, portrait) [[pixel]]s.{{cite web |title=Image generation |url=https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/image-generation |website=OpenAI Platform |publisher=OpenAI |access-date=17 December 2025}} GPT Image 1.5 addresses premature cropping and the warm color bias from the previous model, but it has regressed for generating in some specific art styles. Moreover, the weakness of multiple faces and some languages such as Chinese, Arabic, Hebrew, etc. still remains with the latest model. == Reception == Technology commentators generally regarded GPT Image as significant advances in image generation. [[TechRadar]] highlighted that GPT Image 1 delivers impressive performance capable of producing a wide range of outputs from photorealistic scenes to stylized illustrations, noting notable improvements in text rendering and [[multimodal learning|multimodal]] integration compared with earlier tools. However, [[Heise Group|Heise Online]] reported that GPT Image 1 exhibits technical weaknesses such as over-sharpening artifacts, a warm color bias, and common mistakes in rendering human poses and object overlaps, indicating limitations in output realism despite overall strong performance.{{cite web |author1=Volker Zota |title=Image generator from GPT-4o: what is probably behind the technical breakthrough |url=https://www.heise.de/en/background/Image-generator-from-GPT-4o-what-is-probably-behind-the-technical-breakthrough-10343544.html |publisher=Heise Online |access-date=17 December 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251217085016/https://www.heise.de/en/background/Image-generator-from-GPT-4o-what-is-probably-behind-the-technical-breakthrough-10343544.html |archive-date=17 December 2025 |date=8 April 2025}} == Cultural impact == [[File:AI-generated image depicting Virginia Basora-Gonzalez's arrest in the style of Studio Ghibli.jpg|thumb|An image generated by GPT Image 1 from the [[White House]]'s official Twitter account, showing the arrest of a migrant by the Trump administration. The depiction in the style of Studio Ghibli has been criticized.]] Upon the launch of GPT Image 1 in March 2025, photographs recreated in the style of [[Studio Ghibli]] films went viral.{{cite news
